bio.text: Doris Matsui has represented the city of Sacramento and its surrounding areas in the U.S. House of Representatives since 2005.
She succeeded her late husband, Robert Matsui, who served in Congress from 1979 to 2005, in a March 2005 special election.

She grew up on a farm in California's Central Valley, graduated from the University of California at Berkeley, and served in the Clinton White House as Deputy Assistant to the President in the Office of Public Liaison.
